This is a textbook PAT opportunity: introducing a `MetadataRepository` protocol with `associatedtype Entity` and a `resolve:(id: Int) async throws -> Entity` requirement unifies the two interfaces without loss of type safety. The `shared_field_count: 4` with exactly one differing slot confirms the structural fit. Both files are production code (all context flags false), so there is no intentional-duplication reason to avoid the refactor.
